ModMetaData.name: Grounded: Realistic Stats Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: DrSeedon
ModMetaData.description:
Grounded brings real-world biology and agriculture into RimWorld — without breaking gameplay.
Animals get realistic stats derived from zoological data: body size, speed, lifespan, gestation, litter size, diet, temperature tolerance, meat and leather yields. 59 vanilla animals + DLC + Vanilla Animals Expanded fully covered.
Crops get differentiated economics: potatoes yield more but rot fast and weigh heavy. Rice stores well but needs warmth. Strawberries are luxury goods that spoil in days. Corn remains the lazy farmer's gold standard.
No Harmony. No DLL. No behavior changes. Pure XML — install, play, forget.
Compatible with: Combat Extended, Vanilla Animals Expanded, Alpha Animals, DLC Biotech + Odyssey.
